statement: ∀ (C : Set (WaveMap.Space n)) (t0 : ℝ), IsCompact C → ∀ (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : WaveMap.Space n × ℝ → F) (c : F), (∀ x, x ∉ C → ∀ r ∈ WaveMap.timeInterior t0, f (x,r) = c) → (∀ x, x ∉ C → ∀ r ∈ WaveMap.timeInterior t0, deriv (fun s => f (x,s)) r = 0) ∧ (∀ j : Fin n, ∀ x, x ∉ C → ∀ r ∈ WaveMap.timeInterior t0, WaveMap.spatial (fun y => f (y,r)) j x = 0)
proof:
intro C t0 hc F _ _ f c hf
constructor
· intro x hx r hr
  have hh : (fun s => f (x,s)) =ᶠ[nhds r] (fun _ => c) :=
    Filter.Eventually.mono (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hr) (fun s hs => hf x hx s hs)
  simpa using hh.deriv_eq
· intro j x hx r hr
  have hh : (fun y => f (y,r)) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun _ => c) :=
    Filter.Eventually.mono (hc.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hf y hy r hr)
  simp [WaveMap.spatial, hh.fderiv_eq]
